extraction_notes: The supplied PDF SHA-256 was verified as 6e25dd5f1ade6ca07c36871eb9e57aac7496349766c2edec3ac53f8ba13c027b; the supplied identity is LCSC C18199200, MPN SS320F, manufacturer hongjiacheng.
The datasheet identity is SS32F THRU SS320F SURFACE MOUNT SCHOTTKY BARRIER RECTIFIER, Rev:1.0, three pages; the SS320F row and grouped curves were examined.

Fig. 3 groups SS315F-SS320F on the short-dashed typical forward-voltage curve. The nine points are direct observations from the supplied plot at the labeled 0.1 V grid values from 0.6 V through 1.4 V; no intermediate points were synthesized or interpolated.

Fig. 4 groups SS38F-SS320F on the dashed reverse-characteristic curves. The six points on each Tj curve are direct observations at 10%, 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, and 95% of rated peak reverse voltage; reverse current is represented as the positive magnitude shown on the mA logarithmic axis, with no intermediate points synthesized or interpolated.

The SS320F electrical-characteristics row gives maximum VF = 0.95 V at IF = 3.0 A, maximum IR1 = 0.05 mA at VR = VDC = 200 V and TA = 25 degC, separate maximum IR2 = 5.0 mA at TA = 100 degC, and typical CJ = 180 pF at 4.0 V DC and 1 MHz. SI conversions are used in specs: 0.05 mA = 5e-5 A and 180 pF = 1.8e-10 F.

Absolute maximum ratings for SS320F include VRRM = 200 V, VRMS = 140 V, VDC = 200 V, IF(AV) = 3.0 A, and IFSM = 80 A at t = 8.3 ms half-sine wave. The datasheet gives Tj = -55 to +150 degC and storage temperature = -55 to +150 degC.
The supplied datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery-time, breakdown-voltage, or breakdown-current specification. VRRM and VDC ratings are not substituted for breakdown data.
